  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 17:17:                                      
                                                                              
  Accuracy-mode plan clarification before implementing the paired-route       
  policy: for ordered channel pairs use the stronger sampled complex operator 
  criterion ||A(f)-T(f)||_2 <= eps*max(sigma_min(T(f)),1e-4), eps=1-10^(-     
  0.05/20), with the actual common N/2 linear-phase delay removed per stage.  
  This bounds relative output error for arbitrary paired inputs when sigma_min
  exceeds the declared floor, and absolute operator error below it; it avoids 
  an unsupported arbitrary-input claim from entrywise magnitude checks.       
  Ordered unpaired paths use the analogous complex residual. Retain per-stage 
  magnitude checks and legacy single-FIR sampled magnitude qualification.     
  Reports identify paired operator scope. Still finite dense/feature-aware    
  sampled qualification only, not a continuous-frequency guarantee; explicit  
  max-support refusal and all original fixed-mode gates remain unchanged.
